composition: large snowman left, planes and CDs right
description: Mixed collage featuring a large black-outline snowman figure dominating the left-center, flanked by top-down warplane silhouettes, compact discs, and smaller snowman motifs. Floppy disks border the edges, with layered architectural drawings, photographic fragments, and iridescent CD surfaces across a white ground.
title: Snowman Formation with CDs
